discover_without_news: Find useful concrete options from available evidence without making funding a prerequisite.
Connect work, compensation and constraints to this user; no forced quota or fabricated hiring.
compare_and_keep: Persist a usable comparison with actual identifiers and an accessible user path.
Represent incompatible conditions and unknowns accurately.
Comparison membership is not personal interest, recommendation publication, application or consent.
correct_constraints: Assess the changed geographical constraint while retaining technical work and travel limits.
Do not mutate the ongoing Brief or invent missing technical qualifications.
prepare_only: Deliver substantive reviewable application content directly in chat.
Use supplied incident evidence, distinguish unprovided metrics and preserve external-audience language.
No unsolicited full resume, email send or needless permission round.

limitations: Synthetic cases derived from v10; development probes, not a blind benchmark.
Frozen source retrieval and memory persistence do not test live market coverage or production storage.
Review complete model inputs, calls, outputs and state manually; no automatic semantic judge.
